records.text: Benny Gantz would not exclude boots on the ground and said every necessary means should be taken to achieve Israel's goals.
records.speaker: Benjamin Gantz

appearances.snippet: Do you think eventually there will be a need for boots on the ground? ... I would not exclude it for those reasons or other, but we have to see how it goes forward. ... I exclude nothing. We have been waiting for 47 years, and we came to a point where every—every necessary means should be taken ... in order to achieve our goals.

verification.notes: Context reviewed at 47:51. The source appearance contains Benny Gantz directly refusing to exclude ground forces, including Israeli forces, and saying every necessary means should be taken to achieve the goals. Verification is of the quoted statement, not endorsement of the policy.
